meta.name: rescue
meta.description: Triage an outage, loss of stakeholder trust or a failing engagement direction. Use for urgent recovery; distinguish diagnosis from authorized production mitigation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 突发故障或合作僵局时,快速理清状况并排出恢复步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果线上服务突然中断或重要合作濒临破裂,需要马上定出恢复方案。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a sudden outage or stalled engagement into a clear recovery plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a live outage or a breaking partnership needs a recovery plan right now

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先读取任务上下文契约与 rescue 方法,再对故障、信任流失或失败的项目方向做紧急分诊,并区分「诊断」和「已授权的生产缓解」。它按客户仓库说明和现有工具作业,缺能力或没跑检查会如实说明。
howto.when: 当你遇到线上故障、信任流失等紧急恢复场景时触发;若由 @fde 调用,会复用其当前数据包与范围,不重头开始设置或重复追问。

say.text: 线上出故障了,帮我做紧急分诊
say.note: 先读任务上下文契约,再进入诊断

say.text: 区分一下哪些是诊断、哪些是已授权的生产缓解
say.note: 按上下文契约判断权限

say.text: 我们和干系人的信任出了问题,帮我分诊
say.note: 按 rescue 方法梳理恢复方向

howto.what_en: Claude reads the task context contract and rescue method, then triages an outage, lost trust or a failing direction, separating diagnosis from authorized production mitigation. It reports a missing capability or unrun check honestly.
howto.when_en: Triggers for urgent recovery such as an outage or lost stakeholder trust; when called by @fde it reuses the current sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup.

say_en.text: There's a production outage—help me triage it
say_en.note: Reads the task context contract first

say_en.text: Separate what's diagnosis and what's authorized mitigation
say_en.note: Uses the contract to judge authority

say_en.text: Stakeholder trust is breaking down—help me triage
